International first-year applicants

Guidance for international students applying as first-year undergraduates.

Application requirements

International applicants follow the same application process as all first-year applicants and should submit your application by the published deadline.

English language requirements

International first-year applicants must show English language proficiency with an IELTS minimum overall band of 7.5, or a TOEFL iBT minimum of 105.

Financial aid

International students are eligible for need-based financial aid. We meet the full demonstrated need of every admitted undergraduate.
